POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, APRIL 14, 2025
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM

Sarah Bedy, Member  Doug Killion, Member
Pam Chotiswatdi, Member  Julie Lie, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Sarah Bedy, called the meeting to order at 2:01 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lewis, Lie

Also present: Stephanie Sosa, Community Program Specialist, Jennifer Santana, Secretary.

Roll call taken by Jennifer Santana

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54991  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Policy Subcommittee Meeting of
  Monday March 10, 2025.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Killion, Lewis, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Chotiswatdi

2.  25-54992  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the draft 2025 Homeless
  Services Advisory Committee (HSAC) Policy recommendations to the Mayor and
  City Council.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Lie, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Page 1 of 3
   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Killion, Lewis, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Chotiswatdi

  • The subcommittee members reviewed Everyone Home and have questions
  regarding the recommendations outlined in the city initiative. Staff will work
  on gathering responses and provide updates at the next meeting. They
  would also like to receive the Point in Time Count results once they become
  available.
  • The subcommittee discussed adding a summary of the Mayor’s fund to the
  policy subcommittee.
  • They reviewed the recommendations and agreed on edits including being
  more specific with their recommendations. Chair Bedy will update the draft
  accordingly, and the revised version will be reviewed at the next meeting.
  • Staff discussed the operational cost for mobile showers, Chair Bedy will use
  the information to recalculate the proposed pilot budget.

3.  25-54993  Recommendation to receive and file future agenda items.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Lie, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Killion, Lewis, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Chotiswatdi

  • The subcommittee will check in with HSAC to see if there are any pending
  items they would like the Policy Subcommittee to further explore or address.

PUBLIC COMMENT

  • No public members present during the meeting.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

  • No announcements.

ADJOURNMENT

Chair Sarah Bedy adjourns, the meeting at 2:55 p.m.
